targets.rawSql:
SELECT date as "time", value 
FROM "default"."databook_polyus" FINAL
WHERE ( time >= $__fromTime AND time <= $__toTime ) AND ( table = 'CONSOLIDATED OPERATING RESULTS' ) AND ( data = 'QUARTERLY' ) AND ( name = 'Total gold produced2' )
UNION ALL
SELECT date as "time", value/2
FROM "default"."databook_polyus" FINAL
WHERE ( time >= $__fromTime AND time <= $__toTime ) AND ( table = 'CONSOLIDATED OPERATING RESULTS' ) AND ( data = 'SEMI-ANNUAL' ) AND ( name = 'Total gold produced2' )
ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1000
